Name: New Portrait for NPC Himeko
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]To go along with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46947]New Portrait for NPC Arumi[/url], I've made a new portrait for her daughter, Himeko, also from the mod  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44286]Arumi the Actress - NPC[/url] by NassiLove.  I used Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] to make it. [/size]

[size=4]To use this portrait, download and overwrite the original Arumi mod's assets with mine, then in the original mod's config, set the portrait to "custom".

Enjoy!
